profile.name: Haisheng Lin
profile.advantage1: 7 years of frontend development experience, capable of independently developing medium to large-scale projects, ensuring their smooth progress and timely delivery
profile.advantage2: Proficient in implementing and standardizing frontend engineering practices and possesses strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent cross-functional collaboration abilities

infra.name: Core Technology Infrastructure
infra.introduction: Contributed to the establishment of a dedicated Core Technology Team aimed at enhancing company-wide development quality and efficiency. This team provided essential technical infrastructure and foundational capabilities to support all business project teams.
infra.challenge1: Outdated Tech Stack & Absence of Foundational Infrastructure: Inherited an outdated technology stack with significant gaps in foundational engineering practices, including no CI/CD, inadequate documentation/knowledge base, and lack of reusable component libraries.
infra.challenge2: Lack of Standardization & Technical Debt: Projects suffered from inconsistent practices, low code quality, and rampant code duplication, severely hampering maintainability, reusability, and overall development velocity and quality, ultimately impacting project delivery timelines.
infra.challenge3: Performance Bottlenecks in Map Rendering: Key projects utilizing maps faced severe rendering performance degradation and usability issues due to handling extremely large datasets.
infra.achievement1: Responsible for technology selection and modernization, including migration from Vue2 to Vue3 with code refactoring, integration of TypeScript, linting tools to enforce development standards.
infra.achievement2: Established frontend shared libraries. Contributed core components that are reused by 10+ business projects.
infra.achievement3: Implemented & Scaled CI/CD Pipeline: Researched, selected, and implemented a standardized CI/CD solution. Championed its adoption across projects, reducing manual deployment errors and saving 80%+ of build/deployment time previously spent on manual processes.
infra.achievement4: Solved Critical Map Rendering Performance: Investigated and implemented a tile-based map rendering solution to handle massive datasets. Successfully rolled out this optimized approach company-wide, resulting in FPS improvements from ~10 to 50+, resolving severe performance bottlenecks and dramatically enhancing system usability.

admin.name: Enterprise Admin System
admin.introduction: An enterprise admin system with multi-apps integrated, manages different kinds of enterprise assets. Main modules include corporate information, corporate structure, team management, operation log and enterprise security setting etc..
admin.challenge1: Compilation speed in development mode was too slow and impacted the efficiency due to large scale of project and obsolete technology stack
admin.challenge2: Due to business needs, web app features may differ to that in other environments and the build material of the project in one environment is mixed with irrelevant features of other environments
admin.challenge3: Simultaneous iteration of multiple business lines reduces project quality and maintainability
admin.challenge4: The business needs to support multiple languages, and the daily maintenance of multiple languages is complicated and repetitive, which increases the workload of multiple parties
admin.achievement1: Write unit test cases with Jest and increase average line coverage rate to above 85%. Improve delivery quality and ensure 0 fatal bugs in production
admin.achievement2: Design and implement solution for i18n resource management to reduce the costs of both maintenance and test regression by 0.5-1 hour per human resource in average, and extend the application to other busines
admin.achievement3: Research micro-frontend technologies and apply micro-app to integrate systems from other business teams.

course.achievement1: By implementing the web exception monitoring system, debugging and fixing captured errors, to improve the efficiency to locate bugs, the error rate has been reduced from 16% to 11%
